atAGlance: Gà nướng muối ớt is salt-chili grilled chicken, usually with smoky skin, chili salt rub, herbs, and cucumber.
whatItIs: Gà nướng muối ớt is chicken grilled with chili salt until the skin is smoky, salty, and spicy. The seasoning is part of the crust, not just a side condiment.
howToEnjoy: Eat with cucumber, herbs, or rice to balance the chili-salt crust. Ask for less spicy before grilling because the rub goes on early.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà nướng muối ớt when you want heat built into the grilled chicken. Ask for less spice before the grill, then use lime or herbs lightly at the table.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Gà nướng muối ớt belongs to Vietnamese poultry cooking; look for a lively order when you want heat built into the marinade rather than added later.
goodToKnow: This can be spicy even without adding dip, because the chili salt cooks onto the chicken.
travelerCaution: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
